notes: Version 0.2.0 publishes session 2's review (H-07, 2026-10-29 to 2026-10-30) of version 0.1.0, applied by Task 7c with tools.session_2_pack from the product owner's record (docs/reviews/session-2-answers.md). Q1-Q15 were answered by the product owner; Q16-Q344, T1-T36 and R1-R58 were checked by an AI and count as the product owner's review by their ruling of 2026-10-30. Version 0.1.0 is unchanged.

The records were curated by an agent (Task 7b) from 33 real pages retrieved on 2026-10-29 through the acquisition pipeline. Every record, reviewed or proposed, is never shown as current and never fills a live field (ruling R9).

A record is reviewed only when at least one session 2 row states one of its values, every such row was answered yes, and no answer changed it. Any other record stays proposed: explorable only, never in an unqualified affordable-and-feasible or readiness result (ruling R9). A record no row asks about carries no review.

A no that states the right value, quoting the same page, is a new span-cited claim whose note names the question; a reading a structured shape cannot hold is kept as the page's own words. Otherwise a no, or a ? (the reviewer could not decide), makes the field unknown with the review's reason, or leaves out a fact, with its reason in the record's review. No answer rejected a whole record, so none is left out.

P02 has no target in the fixture (it explores, with no economic solve until its baseline is confirmed), so no record is chosen for it; its cities, Leeds and Manchester, are covered by the P05, P01 and P04 targets.

Skill rows are pack-local (pack:<target>:<row>); the capability reference gives them rubrics. Session 2 accepted no proposed outcome level (R50 and R51, the only numbers, were no), so every planned outcome's level is still null; a reviewed outcome names the rubric its null level was judged against.

A field cites a claim (a value with its span and exact excerpt) or says why it is unknown. A claim whose value is null cites the words that show the value is withheld or absent. Money is integer GBP minor units.

Bodies kept privately (classes govuk, public-sector, course-provider) live in the gitignored var/evidence/corpus/<slot>/ on the curating machine only; job-board and pending pages keep the hash and excerpts only.

Split groups are template families, joined when a page in one is a copy of the same vacancy as a page in another; within each source class groups are numbered by their lowest slot, and groups 2, 5, 8, ... are holdout. A family keeps the split it first got in every class.
